model_name: RIFT Physical Landslide Hazard Intelligence Model
target: landslide_occurred (0: Non-Landslide / Stable Ground, 1: Landslide Occurrence)
limitations: Model predicts long-term and seasonal landslide susceptibility, not instantaneous real-time failure seconds before collapse.
Accuracy depends on the precision of input digital elevation models (DEM) and rainfall estimates.
Vegetation protection ratio uses optical NDVI which may exhibit saturation in dense cloud-covered monsoon periods.
data_sources: Geological Survey of India (GSI) National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) Inventory
